name: tunnel-tops-east
summary:
New final generator step (parts/drifts.mjs) after the lamps and benches: dense native drifts in noise-warped bands (~67% of the ~2,600 free non-lawn park cells), wind-swept flat-crowned Monterey cypress clumps and tall umbrella pines, 3 extra picnic seating walls plus tables and coloured umbrellas, two curved 4-step overlook seating terraces with lamps, the parkway's median barrier and planting over the portal top.
ground.mjs now digs the parkway cut (x76..83 z46..63 at y2) as two carriageways with dashed centre lines and concrete retaining walls, and opens the two bores (dark back wall, hanging lanterns, 1 block of soil over them).
The outer 2 edge blocks, the B lots and every feature position are unchanged; mcd check finds no floating blocks or orphans.
Not fixed: lighting still has dark cells (about the same as v1), and the roof's invalid stripped_dark_oak_log_slab from v1 remains.

revisions.comment:
The module sits right on the terrain and its paths, Campfire Circle and Field Station are good; as the foreground of the hero view it still reads too much as plain lawn. Fix, keeping the box, the ground heights (especially the outer 2 blocks of every edge) and every feature's position:
1. Planting is far too sparse: keep mown lawn only on THE EAST MEADOW, the east end of THE BIG LAWN and the picnic terraces; everywhere else in the park (and the plain grass north-west of the Field Station) lay dense drifts of native coastal planting in irregular sweeping bands following the paths' curves: tall grass and ferns, azalea and flowering azalea bushes (leaf blocks), moss blocks and moss carpet, dead bushes, sweet berry bushes, and wildflowers in colour bands (allium, cornflower, oxeye daisy, poppy, dandelion), 50-70% of the non-lawn park surface, soft grey-green, ochre and purple from above.
2. Trees are round green blobs: make them Monterey cypress and pine: dark spruce / dark oak leaves in wide, flat-topped, layered, wind-swept crowns on short thick trunks, in clumps of 3-6, plus a few tall pines.
3. THE PICNIC PLACE should read clearly: 3-4 terraces stepping down the slope with pale concrete retaining seating walls, timber picnic tables and benches on each terrace, colourful umbrellas (a fence post with a banner or a wool/carpet canopy), planting beds between.
4. THE EAST TUNNEL PORTAL: make it clearly visible: a smooth light-concrete face with two dark tunnel mouths, lit, the Parkway's two carriageways (dark asphalt, white dashed lines, a concrete median barrier) coming out of it eastward in a cut lined with concrete retaining walls, the park's planting spilling over the top.
5. The OVERLOOK terraces on the high south edge: curved, stepped concrete seating terraces (3-4 steps) with timber bench tops facing north, planters of grasses, a promenade with lamps.
revisions.summary:
New final generator step (parts/drifts.mjs) after the lamps and benches: dense native drifts in noise-warped bands (~67% of the ~2,600 free non-lawn park cells), wind-swept flat-crowned Monterey cypress clumps and tall umbrella pines, 3 extra picnic seating walls plus tables and coloured umbrellas, two curved 4-step overlook seating terraces with lamps, the parkway's median barrier and planting over the portal top.
ground.mjs now digs the parkway cut (x76..83 z46..63 at y2) as two carriageways with dashed centre lines and concrete retaining walls, and opens the two bores (dark back wall, hanging lanterns, 1 block of soil over them).
The outer 2 edge blocks, the B lots and every feature position are unchanged; mcd check finds no floating blocks or orphans.
Not fixed: lighting still has dark cells (about the same as v1), and the roof's invalid stripped_dark_oak_log_slab from v1 remains.
applied: 1 Planting: every park cell that isn't mown lawn (East Meadow, Big Lawn east end, picnic terraces, Campfire Circle, station and deck, B lots, edges excluded), plus the '.' grass north-west of the station, gets planting in irregular sweeping bands from warped noise: grey-green (moss carpet, azalea mounds 1-2 high, moss blocks, ferns, tall grass), ochre (tall grass, dead bush, dandelion, rare sunflower), purple-blue (allium, cornflower, flowering azalea, lilac), coastal scrub (sweet berry bush age 3, ferns, spruce and azalea mounds) and a wildflower band (allium, cornflower, oxeye daisy, poppy, dandelion). Planted share: 1,731 of 2,602 free cells (~67%). Added oxeye_daisy, poppy and dandelion to palette.json.

2 Trees: the round blob cypress is replaced. Each listed cypress trunk now heads a clump of 2-4 trees (1-3 added around each where there is room, never on paths, lawns or the tunnel lid). Each tree has a short thick dark oak trunk (2-3 high, with a 2x1 or 2x2 base on the big ones), limbs, and 3 flat ragged pads of spruce and dark oak leaves, stretched and leaning north-east, with a flat top. Pines are tall bare spruce trunks (8-10) with a two-course flat umbrella and a side tuft; 6 were added at extra spots, including on the east edge. Leaf cells with at most one neighbour are pruned.

3 Picnic place: new pale terracotta seating walls with birch seat caps at z40, z47 and z55 join the existing z44 and z50 walls, so the slope steps down as 5 terraces, with the ramp gaps kept. Up to 9 more picnic tables with benches (only where the cells are free), each with an umbrella banner on a fence pole in orange, white, red, yellow or light blue, and planting beds in strips between the table groups.

4 Tunnel portal: the parkway is dug as a cut at y2 east of the face (x76..83 z46..63, inside the edge margin), so the smooth stone surround and both mouths stand clear. The bores are now actually open (before, the ground filled them): black back wall, light grey side walls and pier, a gray road inside, and 12 hanging lanterns. Two carriageways of gray concrete with white dashed centre lines; a light grey concrete median barrier on z55..56 with a smooth stone slab top and lanterns; light grey concrete retaining walls with smooth stone coping along both sides of the cut; azalea and flowering azalea spilling over the lid edge and coping.

5 Overlook: two curved stepped seating terraces (4 steps each: white terracotta risers with birch slab seats, rising south so the seats face north, bowed in an arc) across x4..42 at z~99..110, planting in the beds in front, and lamp posts at the terrace ends.
skipped: Lighting (not in the comment): mcd light still finds dark cells (621 at y7 against v1's 735; about 1,300-1,600 at y5 and y9, roughly as in v1). This step only fills empty cells, so it can't put hidden shroomlights into the ground surface; a later lighting pass would need to add more lamps.
stripped_dark_oak_log_slab is not a valid 1.21.1 block. It comes from the Field Station roof edge and was already in v1; you didn't mention the roof, so I left it.
Overlook 'planters of grasses' are planting beds on the ground in front of the steps, not raised planter boxes.

Planting from directly above still reads mostly green with flower and moss colour, because tall grass and ferns are green in Minecraft; the ochre comes from dead bushes and dandelions. The cypress clumps around the Campfire Circle form a near-continuous canopy that hides some of the planting in the hero view.
